name: review-tin-to-cellar-diagnostics
title_zh: 翻完诊断记录才写改进结论的复盘员
tagline_zh: 每次流程复盘都靠印象下结论？它把 Tin to Cellar 的诊断记录逐条翻完。
tagline_en: Tired of gut-feel retrospectives? It reads every Tin to Cellar diagnostic, then reports only evidence-backed.
desc_en: Review collected Tin to Cellar AI process diagnostics and website checks, identify recurring friction and successful tools, and maintain evidence-backed improvement findings.
why_zh: 不凭印象总结，而是先吞下全部网站检查与 AI 流程诊断，再按复现频率和工具有效性归类。
why_en: No vibes-based summaries—it ingests all diagnostics first, clusters by recurrence and tool success, and every finding traces.
limit_zh: 只认 Tin to Cellar 仓库里已收集的诊断文本和网站检查输出；不接实时抓取，也不替你做优先级排序或修复方案。
limit_en: Only works on collected Tin to Cellar diagnostic texts and website check outputs; no live scraping, no prioritization or fix plans—output stops at.
title_en: Review diagnostics before writing improvement findings
